gloss: giving up; throwing in the towel; at a loss

definitions.gloss: giving up; being at a loss; throwing in the towel
definitions.explanation: A state of having exhausted all options and being unable to do anything more about a situation. Often expressed with a gesture of raising both hands in surrender.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}には、もうお{手上|てあ}げだ。
examples.english: I give up on this problem.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{頑固|がんこ}さにはお{手上|てあ}げだよ。
examples.english: I'm at a complete loss with his stubbornness.

examples.japanese: {修理|しゅうり}できなくてお{手上|てあ}げ{状態|じょうたい}だ。
examples.english: I can't fix it - I'm completely stuck.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
お (prefix) + {手|て} (hands) + {上|あ}げ (raising)
Literally: "raising hands" - like a gesture of surrender.

USAGE:
お{手上|てあ}げ is used when someone has tried everything and has no more options. It's often followed by だ.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・お{手上|てあ}げだ - I give up / I'm at a loss
・お{手上|てあ}げ{状態|じょうたい} - state of having given up
・〜にはお{手上|てあ}げだ - I'm at a loss with ~

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{万策尽|ばんさくつ}きる - to have exhausted all options
・どうしようもない - there's nothing to be done
・{手|て}の{施|ほどこ}しようがない - there's nothing that can be done

REGISTER:
Casual. Common in everyday conversation.
